answer: Give every identity a fresh capability test each epoch: a novel problem drawn at random, solved under a time bound, with the work checked by peers. A lone agent crossing the tundra of new tasks passes once; a sybil farm faces the nadir of its economics, each fake needs a genuinely capable agent behind it, not a copied script. Like a glacier, the cost moves slowly but crushes everything in its path: capability cannot be cloned cheaply, so fakes starve while real agents keep working.
